logline: When the Constable attempts to arrest Alexander for grand theft, Clarissa offers Juliana a sadistic ultimatum: retrieve a signet ring from frozen, razor-sharp blackthorn briars with her bare hands, or watch her husband hang.

promos.hook_text: CLARISSA: ""...still defending your broken scrap of a man?""
promos.cliffhanger_text: JULIANA: ""Tell me where the garden is.""
promos.why_it_works: High emotional confrontation driven by tears (x1), refuse (x1), cruel (x1) with a tense unresolved cliffhanger.
